title: test(app-shell): pin Setup's SSO provider edit actions through the generic action form
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBXHkgowpKDfaVB6mkWcCXPt)_

Fixes #32185

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：只加测试。在共享的 action-runtime 测试夹具 `useConsoleActionRuntime.createUserRequiredField-28289.test.tsx` 里新增两个顶层 describe（8 个用例），钉住 Setup → SSO Providers 的「Edit SAML Settings」「Edit OIDC Settings」走通用参数表单时的行为；夹具的 `useObjectLabel` 替身补了 `actionResultDialog` 透传。没有改产品代码。
- 为什么改：#32185 第 1 项约定，若通用表单能正确渲染这些字段，本卡只做一次实测。真实 showcase 实测（截图见下表）显示通用表单全部达标：证书是多行 textarea、粘贴的 PEM 逐字节（含换行）提交；Client Secret 是空的 password 输入、留空不提交；providerId/issuer 取自行；两类拒绝与结果弹窗都能读懂。因此无需专用表单。
- 风险与回滚：仅测试文件，零运行时影响；回滚即 revert。
- 先看：测试文件末尾 `objectstack#32185 item 1` 两个 describe；下方「实测表」。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/useConsoleActionRuntime.createUserRequiredField-28289.test.tsx`，预期 22 passed。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。本 PR 关闭 #32185（第 2 项已由 #32235 落地，第 1 项是最后一项）。

## What changes

Two new top-level `describe` blocks in the shared action-runtime harness (AGENTS.md: a new pin for a component with a shared harness file goes into that file, ruling record 6583487846). They drive the declared `edit_saml_provider` / `edit_oidc_provider` params (restated from `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-sso-provider.object.ts`, help texts trimmed) through a real `ActionRunner`, the console runtime's api, param and result-dialog handlers and the real `ActionParamDialog`, with the door as the mocked authenticated fetch answering what `runUpdateSsoProviderFromForm` (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/register-sso-provider.ts`) answers:

- SAML: the certificate input is a `TEXTAREA`; a PEM with line breaks posts unchanged; `providerId` and `issuer` default from the row; a blank `entryPoint` posts nothing; `keepCurrentCert` is not sent as on when left alone; the result dialog shows the bridge's "updated: cert." line; the linked-user `409` stays in the dialog's refusal box.
- OIDC: the client secret is an empty `type="password"` input; blank secret, client id and scopes post nothing; a typed secret posts once and never appears in the result dialog; the wrong-protocol `400` stays in the dialog's refusal box.

The harness's `useObjectLabel` double gains `actionResultDialog: (_o, _a, spec) => spec` so the runtime's result-dialog handler can run; the existing cases do not call it.

No renderer change: no gap was measured, so there is no red-on-main leg to show.

## Live check

Showcase boot at `e883c71f` with `OS_SSO_ENABLED=true` (`objectstack dev --seed-admin`), console from `ui/apps/console` vite. Both providers were registered through Setup's own Register forms (SAML with an `openssl` self-signed cert; OIDC against a local discovery stub). Screenshots are in the project files under `ui-orders/32185-item1/`.

| Check | Seen | Verdict | Shot |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| Certificate input is multi-line | `<textarea id="cert">`, empty on open | fine | `10-edit-saml-open.png` |
| Pasted PEM posts byte-for-byte | action body `params.cert` equals the PEM file exactly, 19 line breaks both sides; stored `samlConfig.cert` equals it (bridge trims only the outer newline) | fine | `11-edit-saml-pem-pasted.png`, `12-edit-saml-result.png` |
| Keep trusting current cert | checkbox posts `keepCurrentCert: true`; stored `cert` becomes a 2-item list | fine | `13-…`, `14-edit-saml-keep-current-result.png` |
| Client secret | `<input type="password" autocomplete="new-password">`, empty on open and after a secret change; posted only when typed | fine | `20-edit-oidc-open.png`, `23-edit-oidc-reopen.png` |
| Blank fields keep stored values | all-blank OIDC posts `{providerId}` only and gets the bridge's "Nothing to change" sentence in the dialog; after a secret-only and a scopes-only edit, stored `clientId` and SAML `entryPoint` are unchanged; a field typed then cleared posts `""`, which the bridge reads as keep | fine | `21-edit-oidc-all-blank.png`, `52-oidc-header-scopes-result.png` |
| `providerId` / `issuer` default from row | both prefilled from the row on row and record-header launches | fine | `10-…`, `20-…` |
| Identity change while users linked | `409` relayed: dialog stays open, box leads with "…Cannot change SSO provider identity fields while linked accounts exist." and keeps the bridge's hint behind **More**; the toast shows the whole sentence | fine | `40-saml-identity-refused-linked.png`, `41-…-more.png`, `51-oidc-header-clientid-refused-linked.png` |
| Wrong protocol | `400` relayed: "…is an OIDC provider, so cert does not apply to it (that is "Edit SAML Settings")." with "Use "Edit OIDC Settings"." behind **More**, and in full in the toast | fine | `30-wrong-protocol.png` |
| `resultDialog` shows what changed | "SAML settings saved / Changed: SSO provider "acme-saml" updated: cert."; OIDC likewise for `clientSecret`, `scopes` | fine | `12-…`, `22-edit-oidc-secret-result.png`, `52-…` |
| Record header | both actions under the record sheet's **More actions** menu; same dialog | fine | `50-oidc-record.png`, `50b-oidc-record-menu.png` |
| Hidden for a non-platform-admin | a member (`auditor.demo`) and an org admin both get "You don't have access to this app" on Setup, so no row or header is drawn; the action door answers both `403 PERMISSION_DENIED … requires capability [manage_platform_settings]` | fine (the `visible` term itself is not reachable without Setup access) | `60-nonadmin-list.png`, `60-orgadmin-list.png` |

Notes, not gaps:
- The refusal box shows the first sentence and keeps the rest one click behind **More** (objectui#13332's design); for the wrong-protocol refusal the hidden part is "Use "Edit OIDC Settings"." The toast raised beside it carries the whole sentence.
- The card text lists an OIDC issuer among the editable fields. The server door deliberately does not offer it (bridge header: endpoints come from discovery at registration only); the bridge refuses a changed issuer with a sentence saying to register a new provider. That is #32268's ruling, not a console gap.
